mapper.select: SELECT i.id as item_id, ANY_VALUE(i.name) as item_name, ANY_VALUE(i.img) as item_img, COUNT( DISTINCT uis.user_id ) AS hold_number FROM sw_item i LEFT JOIN sw_user_item_summary uis ON i.id = uis.item_id AND uis.collect_status = 1 GROUP BY i.id ORDER BY hold_number, item_id LIMIT 0,20

SELECT i.id as item_id, ANY_VALUE(i.name) as item_name, ANY_VALUE(i.img) as item_img, MAX(ii.date) as reprint_date FROM sw_item i LEFT JOIN sw_item_info ii ON i.id = ii.item_id GROUP BY i.id order by reprint_date LIMIT 0,20

SELECT u.id AS user_id, ANY_VALUE(u.username) AS username, ANY_VALUE(u.head_img_url) AS head_img_url, ANY_VALUE(u.contact) AS contact, COUNT(uic.id) AS exchange_count FROM ( SELECT id, user_id, item_id, NULL AS sub_item_id, 1 AS source_type, update_time, create_time FROM sw_user_item_collect WHERE deleted = 0 AND exchange_status = 1 UNION ALL SELECT id, user_id, item_id, sub_item_id, 2 AS source_type, update_time, create_time FROM sw_user_sub_item_collect WHERE deleted = 0 AND exchange_status = 1 ) uic INNER JOIN sw_user u ON u.id = uic.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sw_item i ON i.id = uic.item_id AND i.deleted = 0 WHERE 1 = 1
AND i.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
GROUP BY u.id
ORDER BY RAND()
ORDER BY MAX(uic.update_time) DESC, MAX(uic.create_time) DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT uic.id AS collect_id, uic.user_id AS user_id, i.id AS item_id, uic.source_type, uic.sub_item_id, i.name AS item_name, i.img AS item_img, uic.collect_date, uic.collect_price, uic.remark, uic.exchange_remark FROM ( SELECT id, user_id, item_id, NULL AS sub_item_id, 1 AS source_type, collect_date, collect_price, remark, exchange_remark, update_time, create_time FROM sw_user_item_collect WHERE deleted = 0 AND exchange_status = 1 UNION ALL SELECT id, user_id, item_id, sub_item_id, 2 AS source_type, collect_date, collect_price, remark, exchange_remark, update_time, create_time FROM sw_user_sub_item_collect WHERE deleted = 0 AND exchange_status = 1 ) uic INNER JOIN sw_item i ON i.id = uic.item_id AND i.deleted = 0 WHERE uic.user_id IN
#{userId}
AND i.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY i.region_id, i.sort, i.id, uic.source_type, uic.update_time DESC, uic.create_time DESC

SELECT uic.id AS collect_id, uic.user_id AS user_id, i.id AS item_id, uic.source_type, uic.sub_item_id, i.name AS item_name, i.img AS item_img, uic.collect_date, uic.collect_price, uic.remark, uic.exchange_remark FROM ( SELECT id, user_id, item_id, NULL AS sub_item_id, 1 AS source_type, collect_date, collect_price, remark, exchange_remark, update_time, create_time FROM sw_user_item_collect WHERE deleted = 0 AND exchange_status = 1 UNION ALL SELECT id, user_id, item_id, sub_item_id, 2 AS source_type, collect_date, collect_price, remark, exchange_remark, update_time, create_time FROM sw_user_sub_item_collect WHERE deleted = 0 AND exchange_status = 1 ) uic INNER JOIN sw_item i ON i.id = uic.item_id AND i.deleted = 0 WHERE uic.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY i.region_id, i.sort, i.id, uic.source_type, uic.update_time DESC, uic.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT uic.id AS collect_id, uic.user_id AS user_id, i.id AS item_id, uic.source_type, uic.sub_item_id, i.name AS item_name, i.img AS item_img, uic.collect_date, uic.collect_price, uic.remark, uic.exchange_remark, uic.exchange_status AS exchange FROM ( SELECT id, user_id, item_id, NULL AS sub_item_id, 1 AS source_type, collect_date, collect_price, remark, exchange_remark, exchange_status, update_time, create_time FROM sw_user_item_collect WHERE deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT id, user_id, item_id, sub_item_id, 2 AS source_type, collect_date, collect_price, remark, exchange_remark, exchange_status, update_time, create_time FROM sw_user_sub_item_collect WHERE deleted = 0 ) uic INNER JOIN sw_item i ON i.id = uic.item_id AND i.deleted = 0 WHERE uic.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY i.region_id, i.sort, i.id, uic.source_type, uic.update_time DESC, uic.create_time DESC
